justification: Schedule constants and their wording only: cron string, one SQL interval, two site sentences, comments, ledger text. No function bodies changed. The window is pinned by tests that fail on any other value (2 mutants killed).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the toml cron is not '0 2 * * *' or DQ-117's interval is not 3 days
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutants: INTERVAL '4 days' -> test fails; cron '0 2 * * 1' -> test fails.

break_it.scenario: The Railway dashboard keeps the fortnightly value and overrides the new file
break_it.what_happens: CI step 'Railway cron matches config-as-code' goes red until the live value is set
break_it.how: live value set with serviceInstanceUpdate after merge, then the CI step re-run

break_it.scenario: Someone restores a 17-day window and two weeks of missed daily runs pass green
break_it.what_happens: DQ-117 stays green while nothing runs
break_it.how: test_the_old_windows_are_gone rejects 8, 10 and 17; mutant INTERVAL 4 days also killed
break_it.repro: sed -i "s/INTERVAL '3 days'/INTERVAL '17 days'/" scripts/dq_probe_live.py && pytest tests/test_one_outcome_alarm.py

break_it.scenario: A daily run takes longer than a day and the next cron start overlaps it
break_it.what_happens: two runs share the council rate limits and the median still moves, hiding the slowdown
break_it.how: run_unfinished (#1456) goes red for any full run older than 6 h without finished_at, so a long run is red long before an overlap

residual_risk: Live Railway cron must be changed by hand (user go); until then DQ-117 and no_run_2d read red, which is loud.

post_merge.manual_verify: Set dcp-monitor live cronSchedule to '0 2 * * *'; confirm the drift check passes and two consecutive daily run rows exist with finished_at and >= 90% CHECKED.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reuses the existing DQ-117 probe and its schedule test; no new check. url_last_checked is written on every r2_monitor path (lines 1153-1526), so a daily run moves the median daily.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The ledger text already said weekly/8 days while the code held 17 days; the user's 2026-10-14 weekly decision was never applied. Superseded by v7 daily.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Edits existing constants and their tests only; the CI drift step that compares live vs file already exists.

functions.name: test_the_declared_cron_is_daily
functions.input: the text of railway.dcp-monitor.toml read from disk
functions.output: passes only when cronSchedule is exactly '0 2 * * *'
functions.if_none: a missing file or missing cronSchedule fails the test loudly

functions.name: test_three_days_tolerates_one_missed_run_not_two
functions.input: the daily period, the 3-day window, and the 6-hour run limit
functions.output: passes when one missed run is green and two missed runs are red
functions.if_none: no inputs can be None; all are constants in the test
